units.text: Tessa, 17, sits on a dryer typing fast while Jaylen, 17, watches the door and Mo, 16, hugs a duffel that clearly is not full of laundry.
Priscilla, 18, the attendant, mops near the machines pretending she doesn't hear anything.
Colt, 19, in a letterman jacket, leans on the soda machine, eyes locked on the duffel.
ON PHONE: Tessa to Group: "he's HERE. do NOT look at him"
Yo. Mo. You got my stuff or what.
units.name: COLT

units.text: It's not your stuff. It's Wren's.
units.name: MO

units.text: Wren, 17, hoodie up, emerges from the bathroom drying her hands, sees Colt, stops dead.
Jaylen steps between them, Tessa slips off the dryer and edges toward the exit, Priscilla's mop bumps the duffel, and a dozen glossy flash drives spill out across the wet floor like silver fish.
Nope. I didn't see that. I'm on break.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Colt grins and grabs a drive.
The lights flicker, a dryer buzzer BLARES, and everybody freezes as blue and red light sweeps across the front window.
